intro.html: Hey I’m Div. I'm a Principal PM at Care.com in Austin — consumer growth across six care marketplaces, after building the Camps & Activities vertical 0–1.
Before that I was first PM at Gloco.ai, and I co-founded Deliverend and Aggressively Organic (100k+ orders).
People always tell me that psychology and math are two ends of the spectrum. To me they are closer than ever.

education.label: Master's in Data Science, Indiana University —

work.name: Aggressively Organic

body.html: Co-founded the single-pod hydroponic growth pod to end food insecurity, and reduce reliance on brittle supply chains. Fast Company called us one of the world-changing ideas.
Built the product 0-1 with a visionary co-founder, filed patents, built the infra, sold 200k+ pods to individual families, and 300k+ pods to indoor vertical farms including the cannabis industry.
Raised 200k through friends & family, revenue did upwards of $2.5M+ in 2018, learned a lot, failed a lot, had a lot of fun.

items: Featured in Forbes, Fast Company, IndyStar and many other outlets
Won SXSW’s “Food and City” award, and People’s Choice Awards
Licensed patent-pending technology to 10+ farming companies in multiple states

body.html: Joined a scale up. First PM hire. Unblocked order throughput through various optimizations, increased activations & conversion.

ChatGPT released in late 2022, and we got to work on building an AI first regulatory compliance solution for Global Sellers. We took information about your business, where you want to expand to, and told you how to stay in compliance, all for a flat-fee.

items: Was instrumental in Flatfee securing $1.3m in VC funding for Marketing & Product/Eng team expansion.
Led the development of the core product engine responsible for supporting 5,000 enterprise customers, and over $2.2m in annual rev.
Streamlined processes, team rituals, and release cadences driving, 820 new enterprise customers, reducing CAC by 20% and generating $300,000 in direct revenue as well.
Generated 15% increase in revenue by creating and implementing a new AI-based tool for customer support teams to respond to tickets faster.

Owned product responsibility for the Core Marketplace as well as the Fulfillment Portal, which is a part of the Flatfee software ecosystem and intrinsic to the company being able to fulfill over $150,000 of
order volume on a recurring monthly basis.
Led the API integration team, launching successful deep integrations with Stripe and Kangxin.
Led the strategy for channel partnerships, forming a successful partnership with Kangxin, which is a prominent leader in trademark applications in China.

body.html:
